relationships.evidence_quote: Peripheral nerve injury elevated KCR levels in macrophages in the trigeminal and dorsal root ganglia and microglia in the medulla oblongata but reduced KCR levels in sensory neurons.

relationships.subject: C646
relationships.evidence_quote: Inhibition of histone crotonyltransferases (p300) by intra-TG or intrathecal administration of C646 significantly alleviated partial infraorbital nerve transection (pIONT)- or spinal nerve ligation (SNL)-induced mechanical allodynia and thermal hyperalgesia.

relationships.subject: C646
relationships.evidence_quote: Immunofluorescent staining revealed that C646 significantly reduced KCR levels in pIONT TG

relationships.subject: crotonyl-CoA
relationships.evidence_quote: Intra-TG or intrathecal administration of Crotonyl coenzyme A trilithium salt to upregulate KCR dose-dependently induced mechanical allodynia and thermal hyperalgesia in mice.

relationships.subject: crotonyl-CoA
relationships.evidence_quote: Administration of Crotonyl-CoA Lithium significantly upregulated the mRNA and protein level of IBA-1 in TG of naïve mice, as well as the number of macrophages, and this effect could be reversed by C646 treatment

key_findings: Peripheral nerve injury increased histone lysine crotonylation (KCR) in TG/DRG macrophages and medullary microglia but decreased it in sensory neurons.
p300 inhibition by C646 relieved nerve-injury pain and TG inflammatory gene expression, while crotonyl-CoA induced pain, macrophage activation and cytokine/chemokine expression.
